test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

People speak Cantonese in Hong-Kong.

options.text: Cantonese was spoken in Hong-Kong by people.
Cantonese is being spoken in Hong-Kong.

solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'Cantonese is spoken in Hong-Kong.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the** active voice**. We have to change the sentence into **passive form.** 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'simple present tense.'
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Subject + V1 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice: Object + am/is/are + V3 + by (preposition) + Subject.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• Active voice: Madhu writes a novel.
 
• Passive voice: A novel is written by Madhu.
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'People' and the object of the given sentence is 'Cantonese'.
 
• The subject 'People' is not a definite subject, as it is a common noun. So we can omit the subject in passive voice.
 
• So, in the passive voice, the position of ‘subject’ and ‘object’ will be interchanged. 
 
• Also here, 'speak' will be changed into 'is spoken'.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Cantonese is spoken in Hong-Kong.*
